origin: Legacy main item definitions plus original recorded MandoPack archive; user-supplied armor textures and 3D helmet models.
notes: Durasteel armor and the five tools have pack artwork but no recovered item recipes; diamond/netherite tiers and conventional sheet/stick patterns are explicit new defaults.
Helmet and worn textures are user attachments. Plastoid leggings use the original white chainmail layer 2.
Fuel and keys are catalog components only; existing vehicle fuel policy and retired keycard dungeon logic are unchanged.
Right X-wing wing recipe reverses the original vertical row order to disambiguate the identical legacy left/right recipes. Ingredient quantities are preserved.

Repaired cryo_gel model dispatch to existing cyro_gel. Repaired light_frame texture to lightweight_frame. Missing high_efficiency_energy_segment texture uses the original durable_mid_grade_power_core art. Money note has no original pack dispatch and keeps its vanilla paper icon.
Recovered lightsabers reference the separately delivered unmodified official JustTimm pack; shared current saber guard and throw tuning is retained.
